watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}} is covered by cash liquidity, but the buffer is thinner than a year earlier as cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}}.

Interest coverage: coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}, so the cost of debt is rising faster than EBITDA.

Tariffs: the CNMC set the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 at the same level as the prior year, so aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} has limited scope to increase through tariffs.
